
=== Transaction: DB.Extrusora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWExtrusora()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ExtrusoraId);

ExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId if not &ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraId) if not &ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
noprompt(ExtrusoraId);
}
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.WWExtrusora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Extrusoras'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = Extrusora.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusoraId)
	&Delete.Link = Extrusora.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusoraId)
	ExtrusoraNombre.Link = ViewExtrusora.Link(ExtrusoraId, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
Extrusora(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusoraId))


=== WebPanel: DB.ViewExtrusora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where ExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
		Form.Caption = ExtrusoraNombre.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWExtrusora.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusoraId, in:&TabCode);
